Our Process

How we work together

1

Introductory Chat

A relaxed conversation about your goals, timeline, and questions with zero pressure or sales pitch.

2

Learn & Explore

Attend our monthly class or join an open house crawl to get comfortable with the local market.

3

Strategy & Search

We tour homes together, map out neighborhoods, and build a realistic plan tailored to your budget.

4

Offer & Beyond

We guide your offers step-by-step and grab coffee together long after you've unpacked your boxes.
